post.description: Allowed in any open status. Checklist: resolved (store confirmed working), cost_recorded (a live payment line on the issue), invoice_attached (a linked live payment has a file), notes_completed (work_performed) -- all exempt for fixed_by_troubleshooting / not_needed. Anything missing → 422 errors.status (what is missing) + errors.checklist (the keys), unless override_reason is given (kept in the status change reason). final_note / what_we_learned become typed notes (final_notes / what_we_learned) on the issue.
